title: 07. College: Endgame & Borders (17k–12k)
description: Seal open territory boundaries (Yose) before passing so the opponent cannot sneak into your corner.

puzzles.title: Seal the 2nd-Line Monkey Jump
puzzles.concept: Before passing at the end of a game, scan every border between Black and White walls. An open gap on the 1st or 2nd line lets the opponent slide deep into your territory.
puzzles.prompt: Late endgame: Black controls the left side and White controls the right, but one border gap remains open. Seal your territory before passing!

solutions.feedback: Clean border seal! D1 closes the 1st-line gate—if you had passed, White could have played D1 and C1 to erase 4+ points of your territory.
Strong endgame Hane! Pushing to E1 seals the border AND gains an extra point while forcing White to defend.

wrongHints.default: Follow the vertical wall down to the bottom edge—D2 and E2 end at the 2nd line, leaving the 1st-line gate (D1/E1) wide open!

puzzles.title: Defend the Cutting Dame
puzzles.concept: Never pass while one of your boundary stones has only 1 or 2 liberties next to an opponent's wall—connect your weak joint first.
puzzles.prompt: White threatens to push through your diagonal wall at E5. Connect the last boundary point so your entire left territory is watertight!

solutions.feedback: Watertight! D5 links your top and bottom walls into one solid border so White cannot cut into D4.
Strong block! E5 stops White's push and keeps your diagonal wall completely connected.

wrongHints.default: Look at the gap between E6 and D4—White is ready to wedge into E5/D5 and shatter your wall.

puzzles.title: Should You Pass? Left-Edge Leak!
puzzles.concept: SGF Lesson: Passing while an enemy stone sits on the 2nd line (B5) with an open 1st-line slide (A6) lets the opponent steal your entire upper-left edge for free.
puzzles.prompt: You own the upper-left territory (B6, C6, C7, C8, C9) while White holds B4 and B5. Don't pass yet—seal the left edge!

solutions.feedback: Sealed! A6 stops White's B5 stone from sliding up A6-A7-A8-A9 into your upper-left corner!
Aggressive endgame Hane! A5 blocks White's slide AND threatens to capture White's B5 stone!

wrongHints.default: Check the A-file on the far left edge! White's B5 stone is poised to slide straight up A6-A7-A8 if you don't block at A6 or A5.

puzzles.title: Should You Pass? Top-Edge Leak!
puzzles.concept: SGF Lesson: When your wall stops on the 2nd line (D8) next to an enemy stone (C8), the 1st-line point (D9/C9) is worth 2–4 points in Sente.
puzzles.prompt: Black owns the top-right (D8, D7, E7, F7) and White owns the top-left (C8, C7). Close the 1st-line border on the top edge!

solutions.feedback: Clean seal! D9 locks down the top edge so White cannot play D9 and E9 into your upper-right corner.
Sharp Sente Hane! C9 steals an extra point on the 1st line and forces White to defend B9.

wrongHints.default: Look at row 9 along the top edge—D8 and C8 leave the 1st-line gate (D9 / C9) wide open!

puzzles.title: Double-Sente Endgame Push
puzzles.concept: A Double-Sente move gains points for you AND prevents the opponent from gaining points—always play it before neutral 1-point Dame.
puzzles.prompt: Both players have walls facing the bottom-right corner (Black at F3-F2, White at G4-H4). Step into the open corner boundary!

solutions.feedback: Solid! F1 seals your bottom-left territory completely against White's G4-H4 wall.
Strong endgame reduction! G2 steps into White's corner base while keeping your F2-F3 stones connected.

wrongHints.default: Play F1 to seal the 1st-line gate or G2 to reduce White's bottom-right corner.

puzzles.title: 2-Step Endgame Hane & Connect
puzzles.concept: Endgame Hane-and-Connect is the classic 2-move sequence that squeezes 2 extra points out of every straight wall.
puzzles.prompt: Black's wall (E5-E4-E3) faces White's wall (F5-F4-F3). Play the 2nd-line Hane at F2 to squeeze White's corner!

steps.feedback: Step 1 complete! F2 forces White to block at F1, leaving a cutting point at E2. Now connect solidly!
Step 2 complete! Connecting at E2 locks in 2 extra points along the bottom edge with a watertight border.

wrongHints.default: Push around the end of White's wall at F2 first, then connect back at E2 after White blocks at F1.

puzzles.title: SGF Lesson: Don't Play Inside Won Territory!
puzzles.concept: In Area Scoring (Chinese rules), playing extra stones inside your own sealed territory reduces your net score by 1 point per stone—and can even fill your own eye! Once an enemy corner group has no way to make 2 eyes, leave it dead and play the last open border.
puzzles.prompt: White's corner stones (A9, B9) are already dead inside your sealed upper-left wall, while one neutral border point remains at E3. Play the productive move instead of filling your own territory!

solutions.feedback: Disciplined endgame! E3 claims the last open border point while leaving A8/B8 open so you don't waste points inside your own territory.

wrongHints.A8: A9-B9 is already completely dead! Playing inside your own territory at A8 costs you 1 point—claim the open border at E3 instead.
wrongHints.B8: A9-B9 is already dead—don't spend a stone inside your own territory! Seal the open border at E3.
wrongHints.default: Leave the dead White stones in the top-left alone and play the last open boundary point at E3.

puzzles.title: 2-Step Sente Squeeze Over Dead-Stone Bait
puzzles.concept: When an enemy stone inside your territory (B8) has zero eye potential and your surrounding wall has 5+ liberties, ignore it and play the largest open Sente boundary push instead.
puzzles.prompt: White just threw a dead stone at B8 inside your sealed upper-left territory (A7, B7, C7, C8, C9), while the bottom-right boundary (F2-F3 vs G3-H3) is still open. Ignore the bait and squeeze the bottom border!

steps.feedback: Step 1 complete! Ignoring B8 to push at G2 forces White to block at G1 in Sente. Now seal your 1st-line gate!
Step 2 complete! F1 locks down your bottom border cleanly while B8 remains dead without costing you a single point.

wrongHints.A8: B8 cannot make two eyes and your wall has plenty of liberties—answering at A8 loses 1 point! Push at G2 on the bottom border instead.
wrongHints.B9: B8 is already dead—don't play inside your own territory! Push at G2 to squeeze White's bottom-right corner in Sente.
wrongHints.default: Ignore White's dead B8 stone in the top-left and push at G2 on the bottom border first, then connect at F1.
